tool_signatures.name: riskmodels_analyze_portfolio
tool_signatures.description: Use when you have a long-only book of up to 100 names and want its holdings-weighted L1, L2 and L3 hedge ratios, or the ETF hedge notionals for dollar positions. Not for books with shorts or more than 100 names (use riskmodels_portfolio_exposure) or a variance decomposition with return attribution (use riskmodels_get_portfolio_risk_snapshot). Returns, from POST /batch/analyze, portfolio hedge levels at L1, L2 and L3 with per-ticker detail. Only when every position is given in dollars does it also return the ETF hedge notionals at hedge_level (set by level, default L3), by ticker and summed by ETF; with weights, level is ignored.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL

weight.description: Positive portfolio weight, any scale, e.g. 0.4

dollars.description: Positive position value in US dollars, e.g. 25000

level.description: Hedge depth for the ETF notionals, used only when every position is in dollars, e.g. L2 (default L3)

years.description: Lookback window in years, integer 1-30, e.g. 2 (default 1)

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Hedge depth for the ETF notionals, used only when every position is in dollars, e.g. L2 (default L3)

tool_signatures.name: riskmodels_get_fundamentals
tool_signatures.description: Use when you need point-in-time quarterly fundamentals or CAPM cost of capital for one stock. Not for risk or hedge numbers (use riskmodels_get_stock_snapshot). Returns, from GET /fundamentals/{ticker}: TTM profitability and capital-return ratios, leverage, ERM3 valuation betas, cost_of_debt and wacc from reported data, separately labelled cost_of_debt_imputed and wacc_imputed from a market proxy (10-year Treasury plus a high-quality corporate spread, not issuer-specific), economic profit, an equity-bridge decomposition and SEC line items (sec_facts). A quarter is included only if it was filed on or before as_of. grid=true adds an ERP x Treasury-tenor table of cost of equity, wacc, wacc_imputed and economic profit for the latest period. Realized history only, no forecasts; filings are picked up end-of-day. Price: $0.02 per call.
